brief:
With most votes counted from Israel's latest election, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and rival Gadi Eisenkot are locked in a political stalemate, Al-Monitor reported. Neither faction appears able to form a governing majority independently, leaving the two leaders without a clear path forward.

US President Trump may be the only force capable of breaking the impasse by pressuring both Netanyahu and Eisenkot to form a unity government, according to the report. Such intervention could reshape Israel's political landscape by forcing cooperation between the longtime antagonists.
dek: With most of the votes counted, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his rival, Gadi Eisenkot, find themselves in a political stalemate that may only be resolved if the US president pressures them into forming a unity government.
title: Trump could pressure Netanyahu and Eisenkot into unity government
